name: Convertus – AI Website Personalization & Ads Automation
author: convertus

sections.description:
Convertus personalizes your website content for each visitor segment in real time. This plugin is a thin connector: it links your WordPress site to your Convertus account and installs the personalization snippet correctly — including an early anti-flicker step and exclusions so caching/optimization plugins don’t break it. All configuration (segments, content variants, analytics) lives in your Convertus dashboard.

  • One-click connect — no API keys to copy or paste.
  • Caching-plugin compatibility for WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, Autoptimize, SiteGround Speed Optimizer, and Cloudflare Rocket Loader.
  • Free-forever tier (volume-limited) — personalization keeps working after any trial. Nothing in this plugin is paywalled.

See both products in action:

AI website personalization

Every visitor lands on the same page — but they don’t all want the same thing. Convertus rewrites your existing pages for each audience, on the same URL, with no duplicate pages to build or maintain.

  • No new tracking to install — it reads the Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics events your site already fires, so you can start building audiences right away.
  • Build audiences from UTM parameters or on-site events, filter on an event value (equals, contains, or a numeric threshold), and combine segments into clusters with AND / OR logic.
  • The AI reads your page copy and writes a variant for each of the main headlines and paragraphs it finds. You review them, and nothing goes live until you enable it.

For example:

  • Someone who submitted your form but never booked a call sees a page about booking — not the generic pitch they already scrolled past.
  • A visitor who clicked your “free trial” ad lands on a page that continues that exact promise, instead of a homepage saying something else.

Same traffic — you just convert more of it.

AI Google Ads automation (optional)

Convertus is more than personalization. Give it a campaign topic and its AI builds a complete Google Ads Search campaign — data-backed long-tail keywords, ad groups, and ad copy written to match your on-page content, so your ads and landing pages tell one story. Campaigns run with Google AI Max on, so your ads reach AI-powered and conversational searches, not just exact keywords. You review and publish from your dashboard, and AI agents optimize the campaign every week from its performance data. Available on free-trial for everyone and on paid plans afterwards.

Watch the AI Google Ads automation in action

External service

This plugin connects your site to Convertus, a third-party SaaS operated by Convertus (https://convertus.ai). It is required for the plugin to function.

  • On “Connect”, you authorize the link in your Convertus dashboard, and your site stores a secure connection token.
  • On each page view, the personalization script is loaded from cdn.convertus.ai and your visitor’s browser communicates with api.convertus.ai to fetch personalized content.
  • The personalization script sets two first-party cookies to tell returning visitors apart and keep their session. They contain only randomly generated values; see the Convertus Privacy Policy for details.

By connecting, you agree to the Convertus Terms of Use (https://convertus.ai/terms/) and Privacy Policy (https://convertus.ai/privacy-policy/). You remain responsible for your own visitor-consent obligations, as with any analytics or tracking tool.
sections.installation:
1. Create a free Convertus account at https://app.convertus.ai/register and verify your email, then return to your WordPress admin — nothing else to set up on the web app first.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Convertus.
  4. Click “Connect to Convertus” and authorize the site in your Convertus dashboard.
  5. Done — the snippet is injected automatically. Manage everything from your dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Convertus account?

Yes. You can connect (and authorize) an existing account in one click. A free-forever tier is available.

Does this require any coding?

No. Connect in one click and the snippet is injected automatically. You build and manage everything — segments, one-click content variants of the whole page, and autopilot AI campaigns — visually in your Convertus dashboard.

How soon does it work?

Immediately. The moment you connect, the snippet starts tracking visitor behavior, and personalization goes live as soon as you publish your first content variant — no waiting.

Do I need to set up event tracking?

No. The snippet automatically captures your existing Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics dataLayer events, plus any custom events — so you can build audience segments and personalize from day one. If your events carry values, you can segment on them too: contains a value, or greater than / less than a numeric threshold.

My caching/optimization plugin is delaying JavaScript — will personalization still work?

Yes. The plugin automatically excludes its snippet from JS combine/defer/delay for WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, Autoptimize, SiteGround Speed Optimizer, and Cloudflare Rocket Loader. The Settings → Convertus page shows which optimizers it detected. If you use a different optimizer, exclude index.global.js from its JS-delay/defer settings.

What happens when I disconnect or uninstall?

The plugin revokes its connection token with Convertus and removes its stored settings. Personalization stops immediately.

Segments — target visitors by events, UTM parameters, or clusters, with plain-language descriptions the AI uses.
